name: trackiq-amazon-restock-priority
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Restock Priority
summary: Works out which Amazon products to ship next and in what order — days of cover at the current sales rate, the date each one runs out, the date a purchase order needed placing to beat it, the revenue exposed if it is late, and a starting shipment quantity per product. Ranked by revenue at risk rather than by days of cover. Use when the user asks about restocking, reordering, replenishment, days of

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
